author: Myv
body:
Please for the love of God, if there is one thing I would like removed from scrims it would be the fact that deaths count in scrims. It's bs, it shouldn't apply, it's just stupid. I bet no one agrees with me but I just want to get my point across, deaths should not count towards your K/D whatsoever in scrims.

Myv

replies.author: Goodnighht
replies.body: ^ What Blaze said, this shouldn't be in scrim servers, but stats don't mean anything... You could have a 0.000001 K/D and be a god pvper and be really good at bridging, stats don't mean anything, especially in Nebula. If there was one thing that shouldn't be asked in an application for a team would be K/D or stats... If you're going to invite someone to your team you should know what they can do, how well they can do that, and you should practice with them at-least once before you add them... stats mean nothing .-.
